description: This file defines the EmpWorkExperience entity class, which maps to the 'hs_hr_emp_work_experience' database table in the OrangeHRM application. It includes properties representing work experience details, along with ORM annotations for Doctrine ORM integration, getter and setter methods, and relationships to other entities.

classes.name: EmpWorkExperience
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's work experience, with properties for employer, job title, dates, comments, and a link to the employee. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes getter/setter methods for each property.

methods.name: getSeqNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the work experience record.

methods.name: setSeqNo
methods.description: Sets the sequence number of the work experience record.

methods.name: getEmployer
methods.description: Returns the employer name associated with this work experience.

methods.name: setEmployer
methods.description: Sets the employer name associated with this work experience.

methods.name: getJobTitle
methods.description: Returns the job title for this work experience record.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Sets the job title for this work experience record.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the employment period.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the employment period.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the employment period.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the employment period.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Returns comments related to this employment record.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets comments related to this employment record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity associated with this work experience.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this work experience.
